narr: A few strong thunderstorms developed in western Imperial County in the afternoon in a highly unstable environment with above normal moisture levels. Rain rates with the storm were upwards of 2 inches per hour with a few areas of radar estimated accumulations between 1.0-2.0 inches in roughly 1 hour. This resulted in localized flash flooding with at least one reported flooded road in the Salton City area.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding in Salton City with flood waters collecting in Truckhaven and Coral washes. California Highway Patrol reported flood waters were crossing Nile Drive near Atlantic Boulevard, resulting in the closure of the road. No damages or injuries reported.
